sample_unit: chatbot outputs (4 chatbots x 6 oncological operations)

links.outcome: Reading grade level of chatbot consent information versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: No model achieved the recommended sixth-grade level; DeepSeek was most readable (FKGL 9.7; GF 10.8).
links.quote: DeepSeek generated the most readable content (FKGL 9.7; GF 10.8), although no model achieved the recommended sixth-grade level.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of AI-generated consent information (readability scores)
links.effect: No model reached the recommended sixth-grade reading level; best FKGL 9.7 and Gunning Fog 10.8 (DeepSeek).
links.quote: DeepSeek generated the most readable content (FKGL 9.7; GF 10.8), although no model achieved the recommended sixth-grade level.

links.outcome: Presence of systematic referencing and factual accuracy in chatbot outputs
links.effect: Lack of systematic referencing except Gemini, and occasional factual inaccuracies were common limitations.
links.quote: Common limitations included the lack of systematic referencing (except Gemini), occasional factual inaccuracies, reliance on predominantly US-based resources, and failure to assess patient understanding.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the quality and readability of informed consent explanations generated by four commercial LLMs using simulated patient prompts.
